research_question: Does a sparse basis-composition objective improve executable generalization to held-out combinations of observed coding atoms at fixed parameters, tokens, and inference compute?
operational_definition: Compositional emergence is the ability to activate and decode a semantically valid point outside the source-training support by sparsely combining learned basis atoms, while maintaining coefficient-cycle consistency and passing an external verifier.
claim_rule: The emergence claim requires C3 to beat matched controls on held-out executable composition with parameters, tokens, and inference compute fixed.
evidence_boundary: Defines a compositional mechanism test; it does not claim human-like emergence or general intelligence.
